import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Create a territory module folder with a stub
print('=== Creating territory module stub ===')

# First check what's in the source territory file
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('head -30 /root/opt/areloria/server/src/territory/TerritoryControl.ts')
print('Source territory file:')
print(stdout.read().decode())

# Create the stub by copying from source
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('mkdir -p /root/opt/areloria/server/src/modules/territory && cp /root/opt/areloria/server/src/territory/TerritoryControl.ts /root/opt/areloria/server/src/modules/territory/')
print('Created territory stub module')

# Rebuild the server
print('\\n=== Rebuilding server (if needed) ===')
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('cd /root/opt/areloria && pnpm run build --filter=@areloria/server 2>&1 | tail -30')
print(stdout.read().decode())

# Restart PM2
print('\\n=== Restarting PM2 ===')
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('pm2 restart all')
print(stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
